allowedArgs: d=$(command -v docker 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$d" ]; then for c in "$HOME/.orbstack/bin/docker" "$HOME/.docker/bin/docker" /Applications/Docker.app/Contents/Resources/bin/docker /Applications/OrbStack.app/Contents/MacOS/xbin/docker "$HOME/.rd/bin/docker"; do if [ -x "$c" ]; then d=$c; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$d" ]; then printf '{"installed":false,"running":false,"containers":[]}'; exit 0; fi; if [ "$1" = true ]; then a=-a; else a=; fi; out=$("$d" ps $a --format '{{json .}}' 2>/dev/null) || { printf '{"installed":true,"running":false,"containers":[]}'; exit 0; }; printf '{"installed":true,"running":true,"containers":[%s]}' "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | /usr/bin/paste -sd, -)"
